text:
maria: Quick async check — where do we stand on the private deploy for Sequoia Health? Need a short status for tomorrow's sync: network peering, firewall certs, air-gap image delivery, KMS handoff, and final cutover owner.

aj: Network peering is blocked on Sequoia's side — they're waiting on the VPN config from their network team. I sent our templates yesterday. Owner: aj (network). ETA dependent on their SOC approval. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ryan: App-side: PR #428 (vpc-config) is ready for CR — pinged @sarah for infra review. There's one minor env var naming inconsistency which I'll fix this morning. After merge we can generate the final manifests for the on-prem pack.

sarah: Reviewing PR now. Noting a required change: we need to expose the healthcheck port in the management plane with explicit CIDR allowlist. Example firewall snippet we want Sequoia to apply:```
# allow management plane from ops VPN
auth: allow from 10.44.0.0/16 to 172.16.200.0/24 ports 8443, 9000
# allow metrics scraping from monitoring cluster
monitor: allow from 10.50.0.0/16 to 172.16.200.0/24 port 9090
```
Add to docs once PR merges. Also confirm whether HSM uses mutual TLS or token-based — ops-liaison?

ops-liaison: HSM will be token-based for Sequoia (they preferred PKCS11 but have a token gateway). We've exchanged cert signing requests; waiting on their key escrow policy. Owner: ops-liaison (security handoff). There's a short questionnaire they must fill for on-prem KMS integration.

aj: Re: air-gap images — build infra has one blocker: signing key rotation is scheduled this week. I can build a signed bundle after rotation finishes Friday 18:00 UTC. If Sequoia needs earlier, we can do a temporary unsigned bundle under NDA, but prefer the signed one. Owner: aj (image transport).

maria: Good to know. For cutover ownership, who is primary on D-day? I want a single runbook owner and a rollback owner. Suggest: ryan = runbook lead, sarah = rollback lead, ops-liaison = security/PGP/KMS contact. Thoughts?

ryan: +1. I'll own the runbook and coordinate the smoke tests. I'll post a checklist in #incidents with step numbers. Can we lock a 4-hour window (low-traffic) on Monday 2028-06-03?

ops-liaison: That works for Sequoia's ops window. They requested a pre-cutover dry run — can we schedule a dry run Wed 2028-05-29? Prefer at least 2 full run iterations.

sarah: I'll standby for rollback. I'll prepare quick rollback playbook (service stop, KV rollback, DNS failover). Also confirm we have monitoring runbooks tied to engineered alerts.

maria: Outstanding items summary (quick):
- Sequoia network SOC approval (blocking) — aj — waiting on their VPN templates
- PR #428 merge + manifest generation — ryan/sarah — in review
- Signed air-gap bundle build (post-rotation Fri) — aj — ETA Fri 18:00 UTC
- KMS token questionnaire + key escrow policy — ops-liaison — awaiting docs from Sequoia
- Dry run Wed 2028-05-29 — agreed; need calendar invite + runbook links
- Cutover Mon 2028-06-03 (4h window) — ryan lead, sarah rollback, ops-liaison security

Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm ownership or put a quick note if timelines slip. I'll compile into the customer ticket and update the stakeholder doc.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist-run created: checklist/1781234567-sequoia-prep — status: in_progress — missing: network-approval, signed-bundle

aj: :thumbsup: I've pinged Sequoia's SOC again and scheduled a call for tomorrow 15:00 PDT to walk the VPN template. Will update the thread after call.

ryan: I'll finish the env var rename fix and re-request review today. If merged today I can generate manifests and attach them to the dry-run invite.

sarah: I'll draft the rollback playbook and link it here by EOD. Also adding the exact port list to the docs.

ops-liaison: I'll resend the KMS questionnaire and flag the key escrow timeline. Also coordinating dry-run times with Sequoia's ops.

maria: Thanks — I'll assemble the stakeholder note after updates. If anything critical changes, @here please drop short notes. :eyes:
